verdict.rationale: Airbyte supports some event-driven automation primitives: notifications (email/webhook) triggered by sync events, cron-based sync scheduling, and schema-change-management rules that let users define automatic actions (e.g., pause, propagate) when schema changes occur; the API/Terraform provider also lets external orchestrators react to events. However, there is no general-purpose rule engine for arbitrary 'if event then action' automation across the platform. Missing for 10: a first-class rules/trigger engine beyond scheduling+webhooks, documented custom action chaining, and independent evidence of this automation working reliably in practice.
